correctness.rationale: The six published support classes form an independent-set blowup of the triangular prism. With every class size at least two, the exact six-type forcing census controls all complements. The quotient adjacency matrix has real rank four, and the coefficient identities algebraically reconstruct the elementary symmetric data of the three field-order decrements.
